svg.aria-label: Fifteen projects by Mohammad Fayas Khan

g.text: 01 / CROP INTELLIGENCE ROVER
Explainable field rover for leaf disease and risk monitoring.
EfficientNetV2-S, YOLO, Mobile-UNet, Grad-CAM, ESP32-CAM and a 4-DOF arm.
PYTORCH · FASTAPI · REACT · ESP32 · COMPUTER VISION
02 / LPU UMS AGENT
Closed-loop Chrome MV3 agent for live university workflows.
DOM-first grounding, deterministic attendance math, IndexedDB privacy and 139 tests.
TYPESCRIPT · REACT · FASTAPI · MV3 · LLM EVALS
03 / CODE EXPLAIN
AI code tutor with explanations, traces, quizzes and follow-up chat.
Schema validation, self-repair and Groq/Gemini provider fallback in Docker.
REACT · MONACO · FASTAPI · PYDANTIC · DOCKER
04 / SMART CROP
Sensor-driven crop recommendation and plant-health platform.
RandomForest at 93.18% accuracy with 27.61ms inference and ESP8266 telemetry.
PYTHON · FASTAPI · SKLEARN · ESP8266 · HF SPACES
05 / CPU SCHED
Interactive operating-systems scheduling simulator.
FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Round Robin and Priority with animated Gantt charts.
REACT · VITE · ZUSTAND · TAILWIND · OPEN SOURCE
06 / HOMEKIT SOCKET
Native Apple HomeKit HAP server on an ESP8266.
Active-LOW relay safety, Siri control and no cloud bridge dependency.
C++ · ESP8266 · HOMEKIT · EMBEDDED
07 / FACE ATTENDANCE
Facial recognition and geotagging attendance platform.
Real-time dlib recognition with FastAPI, React, Tailwind and SQLite.
PYTHON · DLIB · FASTAPI · REACT · SQLITE
08 / ATTENTION IS ALL YOU NEED
Interactive visual guide to Transformers and self-attention.
Hands-on explanations of the architecture behind modern language models.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · TRANSFORMERS · EDUCATION
09 / DESKBUDDY
OLED desk companion built around an ESP32.
Animated eyes, live weather and clock in a compact embedded interface.
C++ · ESP32 · OLED · EMBEDDED UI
10 / FAYASAI
ESP32 voice assistant with an animated OLED interface.
Groq Whisper speech-to-text and Llama 3.3 responses through a low-overhead pipeline.
C++ · ESP32 · GROQ · WHISPER · LLAMA
11 / NEETCODE SUBMISSIONS
C++ algorithm practice following the NeetCode roadmap.
Consistent problem solving with a focus on core data structures and algorithms.
C++ · DSA · ALGORITHMS · PROBLEM SOLVING
12 / AIU POSTER
Poster and design experiments for AI/ML communication.
Visual storytelling, concise technical explanations and product presentation.
DESIGN · AI/ML · COMMUNICATION · CREATIVE TOOLS
13 / WELLNESS MONITOR
Student wellness monitoring and insight generation.
Explores responsible data workflows for student wellbeing and actionable trends.
PYTHON · AI/ML · DATA · DASHBOARDS
14 / MEDSCAN AI
Computer-vision exploration for medical image workflows.
Investigates structured image analysis and user-facing diagnostic assistance.
PYTHON · COMPUTER VISION · ML · RESEARCH
15 / HACKATHON BUILDS
Rapid web builds from student hackathons and product challenges.
Frontend prototypes focused on clear flows, practical utility and fast iteration.
REACT · NODE.JS · JAVASCRIPT · PROTOTYPING
